description: Security-relevant events from honua.audit_log (Postgres, migration 033). All panels query the audit_log table via a Grafana Postgres datasource with uid 'postgres'. The repo only provisions a Prometheus datasource (docker/monitoring/grafana/datasources/datasource.yml); a Postgres datasource pointing at the Honua database must be configured for this dashboard to render. See #1144.

panels.description: Authentication events (Success vs Failure vs Denied) in the last 5 minutes. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS count FROM honua.audit_log WHERE event_type = 'Authentication' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome

panels.title: Auth Events (last 5m)

panels.description: Authentication events grouped by outcome over the last hour. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS count FROM honua.audit_log WHERE event_type = 'Authentication' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome

panels.title: Auth Events (last 1h)

panels.description: Authentication events grouped by outcome over the last 24 hours. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS count FROM honua.audit_log WHERE event_type = 'Authentication' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome

panels.title: Auth Events (last 24h)

panels.description: Top 10 actors by total event count over the dashboard time range. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT actor, actor_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM honua.audit_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY actor, actor_type ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Actors by Event Count

panels.description: Most recent denied actions (live tail). Refreshes with the dashboard interval. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, actor, actor_type, event_type, action, resource_type, resource_id, remote_ip, correlation_id FROM honua.audit_log WHERE outcome = 'Denied' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent Denied Actions

panels.description: Audit event volume bucketed by minute, broken down by event_type. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '1m', 0) AS time, event_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM honua.audit_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Audit Volume by Event Type

panels.description: Authentication outcome rate over time (Success / Failure / Denied) bucketed by minute. Requires Postgres datasource configured; see #1144.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '1m', 0) AS time, outcome AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM honua.audit_log WHERE event_type = 'Authentication' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Authentication Outcome Rate
